diagnostics.subject: /phases/2
supportedFixes: Select another source or revise the indicated connection/intent

notes: All distances are normalized world meters, times seconds; floor Y is caller-configured. Feet use ball joint pivots, not sole geometry.
60Hz finite differences plus exact phase/contact/window endpoints; seams use samples up to 1/60s either side and may include neighboring short phases.
Joint seam linear velocities remove model-root translation; local angular velocities are quaternion differences in parent coordinates. Peak joint linear speeds are world-space.
Candidate contacts use height AND adjacent speed. Declared contacts are intent, never automatically confirmed. Metadata endpoint support is not treated as a full-clip contact declaration.
The root-bone to pelvis link is a body offset, not anatomical bone length; its variation is measured but never flagged as bone distortion.
Bone lengths/scales compare to imported rest rig, including model-root scale. Authored squash/stretch may intentionally trigger review.
No configured flags does not certify natural motion. Sparse sampling can miss subframe events. Anatomical facing is not inferred.
